createDeck.title: New Deck
createDeck.label: Deck name
createDeck.errorDuplicate: A deck with this name already exists

miscTab.title: Misc
miscTab.autoSuspendDescription: Newly created cards will be suspended in Anki
miscTab.themeDescription: Switch between light and dark mode

guide.firstBookHint: Tap this notification to open the Guide and learn all the features.

oneTap.title: Single tap
oneTap.body: Tap once to show or hide the toolbar.

twoTaps.title: Two taps — translate
twoTaps.body: Double-tap any word to open it in the system translator.

threeTaps.title: Three taps — add a card
threeTaps.body: Triple-tap a word to create a new Anki card for it right away.

longPress.title: Long press
longPress.body: Press and hold any word to select it and open the quick menu.

translate.title: Translate
translate.body: Open the selected word in the system translator.

copy.title: Copy
copy.body: Copy the selected word (or its whole sentence) to the clipboard.

addCard.title: Add to Anki
addCard.body: Add the selected word as a new card with its translation, examples and definition.

wordExists.title: Word already in Anki
wordExists.body: The add button turns into an increase flag button (+F).

more.title: Three dots
more.body: Open the menu with Decrease flag and Delete note.

increaseFlag.title: Increase flag
increaseFlag.body: Raise the flag one step every time you come across a word you don't know.

decreaseFlag.title: Decrease flag
decreaseFlag.body: Lower the flag if you increased it by mistake.

delete.title: Delete note
delete.body: Remove the note from Anki if you added it by mistake.

flags.title: How flags work
flags.description: Every time you meet a word you don't know while reading, you raise its flag.
flags.meaning: The flag shows how many times you have faced an unknown word.
flags.range: Each saved word carries a flag from 1 to 8.
flags.usage: Keep raising the flag on words you keep stumbling on; words you handle easily can stay low.

bookLists.setupAnkiTitle: Set up AnkiDroid to get started
bookLists.setupAnkiBody: RFF creates flashcards directly in AnkiDroid. Install it from the Play Store, then configure a deck in Settings.
bookLists.installBannerMessage: Connect AnkiDroid to save words as flashcards
bookLists.permissionBannerMessage: Allow AnkiDroid access and set up your deck in Settings to save words as flashcards

deleteDialog.title: Delete book?
deleteDialog.message: Are you sure you want to delete "{{title}}"? This action cannot be undone.

toast.ankiDroidNotInstalled: AnkiDroid is needed to grant permission, tap to install it first
toast.ankiPermissionDenied: Permission not granted. Allow Anki access in Settings to connect.
toast.installTtsVoice: Tap to install {{lang}} voice, cards have no audio without it
